manual.why: REJECTED FIX - the underlying record (id 100, still approved with its original fold) was left untouched. What was proposed and declined here was the tag split plus execution edit that would have moved `Partner` out of `equipment` into `swap_equipment` and set equipment to ["Bodyweight"]. The split itself is mechanically correct, but it trips the inversion check on tag-count: swap needs ['Partner','Tennis Ball'] against a primary that needs nothing at all. That warning is honest. A partner is intrinsic to a blind-reaction catching drill - it is the stimulus, not an accessory - so no swap can remove the partner and leave the drill intact. Designing one would mean inventing a different drill to satisfy a check, which is precisely the failure mode the clunk test and the inversion check exist to prevent. Declined by the coach. id 100 remains approved as-is; its folded `Partner` tag is documented in data/known-issues.md.
